description: Open-source screen recorder and editor for polished demo videos.
pre_install:
$launcher = @(
  '@echo off',
  'setlocal',
  'set "RECORDLY_ORIGINAL_APPDATA=%APPDATA%"',
  'for %%I in ("%~dp0..\..\..\persist\recordly\AppData") do set "RECORDLY_PERSIST_APPDATA=%%~fI"',
  'set "APPDATA=%RECORDLY_PERSIST_APPDATA%"',
  'powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%~dp0Prepare-RecordlyPersist.ps1"',
  'if errorlevel 1 exit /b %errorlevel%',
  '"%~dp0Recordly.exe" %*'
)
Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'Recordly.cmd') -Value $launcher -Encoding ASCII
post_install: if (Test-Path $yaml) { (Get-Content $yaml -Raw -Encoding ASCII).Replace('publishAutoUpdate: true', 'publishAutoUpdate: false') | Set-Content $yaml -Encoding ASCII }

script: if (-not $release) { throw 'No Windows ZIP asset found in GitHub releases.' }
